5001e92f-2302-4db7-8daf-6e60c4c44524/Eve.en: Just then, the Miao elders step slowly before the drum, standing in solemn silence.<NL>Each holds a carved horn cup, pouring liquor to the earth as they chant in unison.<NL>Their voices, steeped in ancient tone, ring out like bronze chimes, echoing through the misted skies...<NL><NL>"O ancestral spirits, bless our Miao forever—<NL>May the green hills endure, rice liquor stay sweet, and our people live in peace!"
5001e92f-2302-4db7-8daf-6e60c4c44524/Eve.cn: 便在这时，只见一众苗族老者缓步行至鼓前，肃穆而立，<NL>手持雕花牛角杯，以酒酹地，朗声诵祝，声如古磬，穿透云霭……<NL><NL>“伏惟祖灵，永佑苗疆——<NL>青山长翠，米酒长醇，苗民长安！”

The lively chatter begins to quiet.<NL>All eyes turn toward him, and as he raises his drum mallet, his voice rings out across the field:<NL><NL>"The moon has climbed above the mountain—it's time to choose the loudest Drum Champion of Miao Mountain!"
ed896a00-d6ab-4aa7-ad49-99e3c566ac07/Eve.cn: 暮色四合，鼓场已然亮起火把，照得此间亮如白昼，<NL>这时，一名苗族老者缓步行至鼓场场心，场间喧哗渐渐平息，<NL>一时众人目光皆汇聚其身，但见那老者举起鼓槌，朗声唱道：<NL><NL>“月亮爬上了山头，是时候选出我们苗山最响亮的鼓王了！”

5a74b063-b32d-4ae9-ae44-c5b9d5cae065/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手捧苒心毒，缓步穿过鼓阵，<NL>在经过一面枣木大鼓之时，苒心毒忽而回身望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，不住地招摇触角：<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>！就选这面，你瞧好敦实，敲起来肯定好听！”

22076e1d-12f1-489c-84b3-f348e82e7b3c/Eve.en: The drumlead strides into the arena, raises his mallet high, and strikes—each beat falling like rain.<NL>After exactly thirty-nine strikes, the sound halts at once. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens to Ran Xindu's whisper:<NL>"According to ancient custom, the final strike marks the beginning—"<NL><NL>Since there were thirty-nine beats today, the performance will begin from the thirty-ninth drum and continue in order.<NL>By this count, the drum chosen by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Ran Xindu happens to be in the final group...
22076e1d-12f1-489c-84b3-f348e82e7b3c/Eve.cn: 这时鼓头阔步上场，扬槌击鼓，声声如雨，<NL>三十九声响后戛然而止，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听苒心毒所言，<NL>依照古规，鼓声落处便是起始之处——<NL><NL>今日既敲三十九声，便从第三十九面鼓起，依次奏响，<NL>如此数来，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与苒心毒所选之鼓，恰为最末一组……

a0fe0595-4f90-4d9b-ab80-6a3874e96265/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>静立鼓旁等候，<NL>苒心毒聆听着场中传来的阵阵鼓乐，不时鼓掌喝彩……
a0fe0595-4f90-4d9b-ab80-6a3874e96265/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> тихо стоит рядом с барабаном и ждет.<NL>Ран Синду внимательно прислушивается к ритмам, эхом разносящимся по арене, время от времени подбадривая и хлопая в ладоши...

f5952f89-cf96-4974-afa4-edbf6f0796be/Eve.en: A Miao maiden steps into the circle, singing as she beats the drum. Her voice rings out, bright as spring water striking stone:<NL><NL>"One strike shakes the mountain high, / Silvered tribes greet the moon in the sky.<NL>We dance till flames reach past the cloud! / We stomp till flowers burst from the ground!<NL>Hei-ho! Hei-ho! Let the moon not fall tonight! / Keep the drum alive—keep your feet in flight!"<NL><NL>Silver butterflies shimmer in her hair, bells at her wrist chime in harmony.<NL>Ran Xindu smiles softly and hums along: "Let the moon not fall tonight..."
f5952f89-cf96-4974-afa4-edbf6f0796be/Eve.cn: 场中一名苗族少女击鼓高歌，声如清泉击石：<NL><NL>“一槌鼓响震山崖嘛，百寨银衣迎月摆啰，<NL>跳得篝火卷云上嘛，踩得大地裂开花哎，<NL>嘿嚯！嘿嚯！今夜不许月亮落！鼓不停哎～脚莫呆！”<NL><NL>少女发间银蝶振翅欲飞，手腕银铃相和成歌，<NL>苒心毒眼含笑意，轻声相和：“今夜不许月亮落……”

aa8e02aa-6dbc-44ec-836c-405d5bb395d4/Eve.en: A Miao youth strikes the drum with thunderous force. His voice bursts out like lightning cracking the sky:<NL><NL>"Hei—ho!<NL>Like rain my mallet on drum it falls! / The drum shakes the very clouds!<NL>Tonight the torches blaze the heavens, / Who shall become the Drum Champion?<NL>Whose rhythm echoes farthest wide? / From mountaintop to village side?"<NL><NL>Ran Xindu rises on her toes, hums along, then laughs slyly: "Hmph, once my drumming starts...<NL>Even the mountain gods will pop their heads out in shock!"
aa8e02aa-6dbc-44ec-836c-405d5bb395d4/Eve.cn: 场中一名苗族少年挥槌击鼓，声如惊雷轰鸣：<NL><NL>“嘿——嗬！<NL>槌落如雨点嘛，鼓声震云霄啰，<NL>今夜火把烧天红嘛，鼓王称号属谁人喂？<NL>哪个鼓声传得最远嘛，寨头寨尾都认同喂！”<NL><NL>苒心毒踮脚轻哼，嘻嘻一笑：“哼，待会儿我的鼓声一响，<NL>保管连山神都要惊得探出头来！”

e38bebd9-6fa5-4300-bfae-088c674eee41/Eve.en: A Miao woman steps forward, drum mallet in hand. Her strikes roll like distant thunder, and her song resounds with ancient strength:<NL><NL>"The river flows long, / Our ancestors journeyed south.<NL>Ninety-nine winding turns, / Embroidered on my blouse.<NL>In my silver collar, the fire lies curled, / And rice fields ripple, on skirts that swirled.<NL>Hey—yo... Hey—yo... the moon still trails our tread, / Shining on peaks where spirits are fed!"<NL><NL>Tears glimmer in Ran Xindu's eyes as she listens, her voice soft with awe: "Her singing... it's so moving. Her drumming too..."<NL>She quickly wipes her eyes, then lifts her chin defiantly: "But still—not as good as mine!"
e38bebd9-6fa5-4300-bfae-088c674eee41/Eve.cn: 场中一名苗族妇人执槌击鼓，声如沉雷，歌声苍劲：<NL><NL>“河水长流哟，祖魂向南迁，<NL>九十九道弯哎，绣在衣襟边,<NL>银项圈里藏火种嘛，百褶裙上写稻田，<NL>嘿——哟……月亮追着脚印走哎……照我苗山万万年！”<NL><NL>苒心毒听得眼中泪光闪动，喃喃道：“这个阿嬷唱呢好……敲呢也好……”<NL>苒心毒说着，抹了抹眼角，下巴一扬：“不过肯定没有我呢好……”

e5f7fd22-8040-4eb4-a8d1-56fe2649f2da/Eve.en: An elderly Miao man staggers into the ring, clearly inebriated. He sways on unsteady feet, lifting his drum mallet with wild abandon. His song is slurred, off-key, and utterly chaotic:<NL><NL>"Had too much rice liquor, lost my head, / Thought the moon was a drum instead!<NL>Swung my mallet and kissed the ground, / Crown flew off and toad was found!<NL>Lyrics? Left 'em in a maple tree, / Croaked my tune through rounds of three!<NL>Made the mountain god laugh 'til he cried, / And Butterfly Mother cover her eyes!<NL>Can a tipsy fool with legs all wrong—/ Steal the crown with a slurred-out song?"<NL><NL>At the song's climax, the drum mallet flies from his grip and lands headfirst in the dirt.<NL>The crowd freezes in stunned silence, then erupts into thunderous laughter. Ran Xindu doubles over, wheezing with delight...
e5f7fd22-8040-4eb4-a8d1-56fe2649f2da/Eve.cn: 场中一名苗族老者醉步踉跄，挥槌击鼓，荒腔走板：<NL><NL>“昨夜米酒喝太多嘛，把月亮看成大鼓哟！<NL>一槌扑空摔个趴哎，银冠扣住癞蛤蟆！<NL>歌词忘在枫树杈嘛，乱唱也能过三关嘛，<NL>定是山神笑掉牙，蝴蝶妈妈捂住眼嘛～醉鬼也能当鼓王？”<NL><NL>老者唱到酣处，鼓槌脱手飞出，直插入土，<NL>全场先是一静，随即爆发出震天哄笑，苒心毒更是笑得前仰后合……

131a2c19-8e3b-42e6-8742-7fba4224186d/Eve.en: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, wait a moment..."<NL><NL>Ran Xindu suddenly turns, flashing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> a sly wink and a mischievous smile.<NL>A soft glimmer then flicks from her feelers—silent as moonlight—vanishing into the drum without a trace.
131a2c19-8e3b-42e6-8742-7fba4224186d/Eve.cn: “<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>等一哈……”<NL><NL>苒心毒忽而转过身，对着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眨眨眼睛，狡黠一笑，<NL>而后只见一点莹光自她触角飞出，悄无声息地没入鼓中……
131a2c19-8e3b-42e6-8742-7fba4224186d/Eve.ru: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, подождите минутку..."<NL><NL>Ран Синду внезапно поворачивается, сверкая <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> хитрое подмигивание и озорная улыбка.<NL>Затем мягкое мерцание срывается с ее щупалец — бесшумное, как лунный свет, — и бесследно исчезает в барабане.

024610ec-c98e-4753-9f5c-2d0d7cbbc732/Eve.en: Ran Xindu's feelers twitch with glee as she declares proudly:<NL>"With this little fellow helping me out, I've got the Drum Champion title in the bag! Just you watch, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>!"
024610ec-c98e-4753-9f5c-2d0d7cbbc732/Eve.cn: 苒心毒触角轻扬，带着几分得意道：<NL>“有这小家伙相助，包管我能夺下鼓王，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>瞧好咯！”
024610ec-c98e-4753-9f5c-2d0d7cbbc732/Eve.ru: Щупальца Ран Синду подергиваются от ликования, когда она гордо заявляет:<NL>"Благодаря тому, что этот малыш помогает мне, у меня в кармане титул чемпиона по игре на барабанах! Просто наблюдай, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>!"

02c92622-39a5-44ea-8e49-1bb8f8ba8a96/Eve.en: Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can ask, Ran Xindu's feelers sway with flair.<NL>The jujube-wood drum rises at her command, releasing a low, resonant hum.<NL><NL>The sound begins like silver chimes dancing through a mountain stream, then shifts to resemble birds flitting through the treetops.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens intently, memories of that first meeting with Ran Xindu at the Five Venoms Valley rise unbidden.<NL>In the layered rhythm of the drumbeat, long-buried moments come vividly to life...
02c92622-39a5-44ea-8e49-1bb8f8ba8a96/Eve.cn: 不待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>追问，<NL>苒心毒触角招摇，那面枣木大鼓应声而起，发出一阵低沉的嗡鸣，<NL><NL>但闻那鼓声初时如银铃荡过山涧，渐而又好似百鸟掠过林梢，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>凝神细听，竟不由得想到与苒心毒于五毒浴谷初见之时，<NL>一时间，万千往事，竟都在这高低错落的鼓音中一一浮现心头……

02c92622-39a5-44ea-8e49-1bb8f8ba8a96/Opt.en: (This drumbeat stirs something within me... unexpectedly touching.)
02c92622-39a5-44ea-8e49-1bb8f8ba8a96/Opt.ru: (Этот барабанный бой пробуждает что-то внутри меня... неожиданно трогательное.)

abdd103f-b9ab-437d-bc34-749997204045/Eve.en: "This drum... reminds me of granny,<NL>by the fire, spinning and scolding me for staying out. It stings the heart..."<NL>"Sigh... sounds like my brother's off-key flute. I teased he'd never win a girl's heart..."<NL>"..."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks around. People wipe their tears, murmuring softly.<NL>They all hear the same tune, yet feel different things... How strange...
abdd103f-b9ab-437d-bc34-749997204045/Eve.cn: “这鼓声让我想起了阿嬷，<NL>她坐火塘边纺麻，骂我贪玩不归家，听呢人心发酸……”<NL>“唉……这调子好像阿弟吹芦笙走调的模样……我当初还笑他讨不了阿妹欢心……”<NL>“……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>环视四周，但见众人垂首拭泪，喃喃之语此起彼伏，<NL>人人分明同闻一曲，心中所感竟各不相同，不禁暗自诧异……

abdd103f-b9ab-437d-bc34-749997204045/Opt.en: (Does it have something to do with the Gu Ran Xindu hid in the drum...?)
abdd103f-b9ab-437d-bc34-749997204045/Opt.cn: （莫非……与苒心毒放入鼓中的蛊虫有何关系……）
abdd103f-b9ab-437d-bc34-749997204045/Opt.ru: (Это как-то связано с тем, что Гу Ран Синду спрятался в барабане...?)

a6d7f17c-2a28-4861-ae60-c19353077bf4/Eve.en: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, wait a moment..."<NL><NL>Ran Xindu Ran tugs at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s sleeve,<NL>winks playfully, flashing a sly grin,<NL>then slips a gleaming Gu from her sleeve and quietly drops it into the drum...
a6d7f17c-2a28-4861-ae60-c19353077bf4/Eve.cn: “<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>等一哈……”<NL><NL>苒心毒拉住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>衣袖，<NL>对着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>眨眨眼睛，狡黠一笑，<NL>然后从袖中取出一只通体的蛊虫，然后悄悄放入了鼓中……
a6d7f17c-2a28-4861-ae60-c19353077bf4/Eve.ru: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, подождите минутку..."<NL><NL>Ран Синду Ран дергает за <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>рукав,<NL>игриво подмигивает, сверкая лукавой усмешкой,<NL>затем достает из рукава блестящую Гу и тихо опускает ее в барабан...

b3b1f33d-9967-4812-91b0-266149252694/Eve.en: Ran Xindu leans close to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s ear, a smug glint in her eyes:<NL>"With this little fellow helping me out, I've got the Drum Champion title in the bag! Just you watch, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>!"
b3b1f33d-9967-4812-91b0-266149252694/Eve.cn: 苒心毒凑近<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>耳朵，带着几分得意道：<NL>“有这小家伙相助，包管我能夺下鼓王，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>瞧好咯！”
b3b1f33d-9967-4812-91b0-266149252694/Eve.ru: Ран Синду наклоняется поближе к <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>ухо, самодовольный блеск в ее глазах:<NL>"Благодаря тому, что этот малыш помогает мне, у меня в кармане титул чемпиона по игре на барабанах! Просто наблюдай, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>!"

af9e9243-15be-49ca-b352-83933e604053/Eve.en: Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can ask, Ran Xindu lifts the mallet and strikes the drum.<NL>At once, the jujube-wood drum releases a low, resonant hum.<NL><NL>The sound begins like silver chimes rippling through a mountain stream, then shifts to resemble birds flitting through the treetops.<NL>As <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens intently, memories of that first meeting with Ran Xindu at the Five Venoms Valley rise unbidden.<NL>In the layered rhythm of the drumbeat, long-buried moments come vividly to life...
af9e9243-15be-49ca-b352-83933e604053/Eve.cn: 不待<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>追问，苒心毒执槌击鼓，<NL>那面枣木大鼓登时发出一阵低沉的嗡鸣，<NL><NL>但闻那鼓声初时如银铃荡过山涧，渐而又好似百鸟掠过林梢，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>凝神细听，竟不由得想到与苒心毒于五毒浴谷初见之时，<NL>一时间，万千往事，竟都在这高低错落的鼓音中一一浮现心头……

af9e9243-15be-49ca-b352-83933e604053/Opt.en: (This drumbeat stirs something within me... unexpectedly touching.)
af9e9243-15be-49ca-b352-83933e604053/Opt.ru: (Этот барабанный бой пробуждает что-то внутри меня... неожиданно трогательное.)

b6597b34-f500-45a1-9b59-fc8daa9288cc/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s thoughts stir, and Ran Xindu suddenly glances back,<NL>winking her left eye with a sly grin—<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> already knows what she's up to:<NL><NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>'s so sharp! This here's my secret Gu, y'know!<NL>Anyone who hears my drumming will start thinking of the stuff they miss most deep down...<NL>Once they're all teary-eyed, they'll for sure crown me the Drum Champion!"
b6597b34-f500-45a1-9b59-fc8daa9288cc/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念方动，苒心毒忽地回眸，<NL>轻眨左眼，狡黠一笑，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>已然知其心中所想：<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>好聪明哟，这各就是我呢秘蛊啦，<NL>谁听了我呢鼓声，就会想到最牵肠挂肚呢往事……<NL>大伙儿听呢眼泪汪汪，肯定就会选我做鼓王啦！”

7de678b1-18f4-4438-a759-ca50c50c18e7/Eve.en: Just then, a muffled pop echoes through the air.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns toward the sound,<NL>only to see a finger-sized hole torn into the drumhead—and a crimson Gu slowly crawling out.<NL>Ran Xindu gasps, then starts stomping her feet in panic.<NL><NL>"Oh no! Why do you gotta eat everything? Now you've gone and ruined my drum!<NL>How am I supposed to play it now? How am I gonna win the Drum Champion title?!"
7de678b1-18f4-4438-a759-ca50c50c18e7/Eve.cn: 正在这时，<NL>只听“噗”的一声闷响，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循声望去，<NL>只见鼓面上竟破开个指头大的窟窿，一只通体赤色的蛊虫从洞中慢悠悠钻出，<NL>苒心毒见此，“啊呀”一声惊叫，登时急得连连跺脚：<NL><NL>“哎哟，你咋各什么都要吃，你吃坏了我呢鼓，<NL>我还咋各敲，咋各夺鼓王……”

971cba5e-c88a-4a73-98bc-913d5223f0e1/Eve.en: The drum falls silent. The crowd stirs, as if waking from a dream.<NL>They wipe away tears, puzzled looks on their faces. Whispered voices rise:<NL><NL>"Why'd I suddenly think of my granny? She's been gone so long..."<NL>"I hadn't thought of my brother in ages. He died with that Naxi girl on Tianshan Mountains.<NL>Kangmeijiumingjin and Zhuguyulepai guided them to the snow mountains... where nothing could keep them apart."<NL>"That drum's strange... maybe a Gu witch channeled a parasite into it..."<NL>"Never heard of that kind of Gu. You're just overthinking it, granny..."
971cba5e-c88a-4a73-98bc-913d5223f0e1/Eve.cn: 鼓声戛然而止，众人如梦初醒，<NL>纷纷拭去眼角泪痕，面露困惑之色，场中一时窃窃私语：<NL><NL>“方才怎就突然想起阿嬷，她都走了好多年……”<NL>“我也好久没得想起阿弟了，他同纳西族呢姑娘殉情在了天山，<NL>康美久命金与朱古羽勒排接引他们去往了游翠郭，在那里……再也没有人能阻碍他们……”<NL>“这鼓声好生奇怪……怕不是被蛊婆下蛊了哦……”<NL>“我还没听过这种蛊呢，老人家想多咯……”

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Eve.en: Ran Xindu flushes at the words, her gaze flickering.<NL>But she quickly lifts her chin and straightens her back, muttering:<NL><NL>"So... so what if I did use a Gu? Winning still counts as my skill..."
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Eve.cn: 苒心毒闻言面颊微红，眼神游移了一瞬，<NL>随即下巴一扬，强自挺直腰板嘟囔道：<NL><NL>“下、下蛊啷个了嘛！能赢就是我呢本事……”
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Eve.ru: Ран Синду краснеет от этих слов, ее взгляд вспыхивает.<NL>Но она быстро вздергивает подбородок и выпрямляет спину, бормоча:<NL><NL>- Так... так что, если я действительно использовал Гу? Победа по-прежнему считается моим мастерством..."

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.en: If your heart is open and aboveboard, does the title of Drum Champion truly matter?
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.cn: 以蛊取胜，并非正道，你若正大光明，是与不是鼓王，有何重要？
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.ru: Если ваше сердце открыто и искреннее, действительно ли имеет значение титул чемпиона по игре на барабанах?

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.en: The Drum Festival is about its spirit, not the result. You're already the Drum Champion in my heart...
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.cn: 苗鼓节重在参与，不必在意输赢，何况你已是我心中鼓王……
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.ru: Фестиваль барабанов - это его Дух, а не результат. В моем сердце ты уже чемпион по игре на барабанах...

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.en: Sure, Gu might work—but in my view, that's not real victory.
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.cn: 以蛊取胜自是虽是办法，不过以我来看，并非取胜之道……
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.ru: Конечно, Гу могло бы сработать, но, на мой взгляд, это не настоящая победа.

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.en: Makes sense... though tell me, are you sure we didn't stumble into the Gu Festival by mistake?
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.cn: 言之有理，不过咱们是不是来错地方啦，你要去的应当是蛊王节？
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.ru: В этом есть смысл... Хотя скажи мне, ты уверен, что мы не попали на фестиваль Гу по ошибке?

9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.en: There's no rule that bars any path to victory, but with your skills, why did you lean on Gu at all?
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.cn: 取胜之道，本无禁忌。但以你的真本领，又何须借力于蛊？
9d609f4a-950f-4ace-a36e-02339ddf1858/Opt.ru: Нет такого правила, которое преграждало бы любой путь к победе, но с вашими навыками, почему вы вообще доверились Гу?

32520f3c-29ec-4c4f-af40-aa3ecc4447e0/Eve.en: "If I were truly open and aboveboard, then the title of Drum Champion doesn't truly matter..."<NL>As Ran Xindu speaks, her bright eyes drift involuntarily toward the ceremonial drum at the center of the arena.<NL>Her voice fades as she reaches the end: "But still..."<NL><NL>Seeing her like this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't help but feel a pang of softness, and speaks gently to comfort her...
32520f3c-29ec-4c4f-af40-aa3ecc4447e0/Eve.cn: “若正大光明，是与不是鼓王，也不重要嘛……”<NL>苒心毒说着话，一双明眸却不由自主地飘向会场中央的祭鼓，<NL>话到末尾，声气渐渐弱了下去：“可是……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见她这般模样，不由心中一软，温言宽慰道……

32520f3c-29ec-4c4f-af40-aa3ecc4447e0/Opt.en: Remember, a drum speaks through feeling—only when it comes from the heart can it move others.
32520f3c-29ec-4c4f-af40-aa3ecc4447e0/Opt.cn: 你且记得鼓声传情，发自于心，方能感人。
32520f3c-29ec-4c4f-af40-aa3ecc4447e0/Opt.ru: Помните, барабан говорит через чувства — только когда он исходит из сердца, он может тронуть других.

8987f1d0-0554-4abd-a93a-fe3d19e30a74/Eve.en: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>'s words... are so profound..."<NL><NL>Ran Xindu lowers her head, seemingly puzzled, lost in thought.
8987f1d0-0554-4abd-a93a-fe3d19e30a74/Eve.cn: “<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>呢话……好高深……”<NL><NL>苒心毒闻言似是不解，当下垂首思索……
8987f1d0-0554-4abd-a93a-fe3d19e30a74/Eve.ru: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>его слова... они настолько глубоки..."<NL><NL>Ран Синду опускает голову, по-видимому, озадаченная, погруженная в свои мысли.

7c20bd34-f809-44e3-b1cc-35039dca48f8/Eve.en: Just then, a Miao elder in ceremonial dress steps forward to stand before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>,<NL>his gaze gentle as it settles upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>:<NL><NL>"Outlander, the heart of the drum is torn, yet the mountain wind still blows, and the moon still hangs high.<NL>Will you go on drumming?"
7c20bd34-f809-44e3-b1cc-35039dca48f8/Eve.cn: 这时，<NL>一位身着盛装的苗族老者缓步走至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，<NL>目光温和地落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身上：<NL><NL>“外乡人，鼓心破了，但山风没停，月亮还在天上，<NL>你各还要继续敲鼓呢？”

659cc4e1-d9ee-4635-b60f-edc4de2c5c45/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks down at the little creature in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> palm.<NL>Ran Xindu stands tall, feelers raised high and eyes shining bright—<NL>as though she has grasped the meaning behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words.<NL><NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, I'll keep drumming!<NL>Even if I never earn the title of Drum Champion, I'll still drum out what's in my heart—for everyone to hear..."
659cc4e1-d9ee-4635-b60f-edc4de2c5c45/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>看向掌中虫儿，<NL>但见苒心毒昂首挺胸，触角高扬，双目清亮，<NL>似是已然想通<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>言中之意……<NL><NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，我要继续敲鼓！<NL>就算拿不着鼓王，我也要把我心头想呢，敲给大家听……”

659cc4e1-d9ee-4635-b60f-edc4de2c5c45/Opt.en: (Then strike the drum, and let your heart be heard!)
659cc4e1-d9ee-4635-b60f-edc4de2c5c45/Opt.cn: （好，便将你心中所想，敲给大家听。）
659cc4e1-d9ee-4635-b60f-edc4de2c5c45/Opt.ru: (Тогда ударь в барабан, и пусть твое сердце будет услышано!)

38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> clasps <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hands in a respectful salute to the Miao elder and calls out with spirit—
38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>朝苗族老者抱拳一礼，朗声便道……
38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> застежки <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> протягивает руку в почтительном приветствии старейшине Мяо и с Духом восклицает—

38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Opt.en: The mountain wind still blows, and the moon still hangs high—of course I'll keep drumming!
38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Opt.cn: 山风没停，月亮还在天上，自然要敲！
38744d5f-d52c-4874-8c9c-c3e538cd5eae/Opt.ru: Горный ветер все еще дует, и луна все еще висит высоко — конечно, я продолжу барабанить!

cd80503f-b732-4f2f-bfdb-8f8c9d59cb3e/Eve.en: "Well said, traveler! You've a bit of that Miao spirit in you!"<NL>The elder lets out a hearty laugh, his face full of praise. With a wave of his hand, he says:<NL>"Still, your drumhead's broken. Let me fetch you a new one!"<NL><NL>Before his words have fully fallen, Ran Xindu in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s palm begins to wave its feelers urgently.<NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, isn't there a drum in your belongings? Just use that one!<NL>The hide on it is thick—it's a good drum!"
cd80503f-b732-4f2f-bfdb-8f8c9d59cb3e/Eve.cn: “好个外乡人！倒有几分我们苗家的爽快！”<NL>老者闻言朗声大笑，面露赞许之色，随即挥手道：<NL>“不过你们呢鼓心破啦，我给你们换面新鼓！”<NL><NL>老者话音未落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>掌中的小虫突然急急摇动触角，<NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，你呢行囊不是有一面鼓嘛，用那个鼓就好啦！<NL>那个鼓皮儿厚，是面好鼓哩！”

cd80503f-b732-4f2f-bfdb-8f8c9d59cb3e/Opt.ru: (Барабан... ты имеешь в виду Львиный барабан?)

d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Eve.en: Ran Xindu keeps nodding eagerly.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> picks up on the cue and gives a knowing nod, then promptly cups <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hands in salute, politely declining the elder's offer.
d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Eve.cn: 苒心毒不住点头，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>会意颔首，当即向老者拱手推辞……
d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Eve.ru: Ран Синду продолжает нетерпеливо кивать.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> улавливает намек и понимающе кивает, затем быстро выпивает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> поднимаю руки в приветствии, вежливо отклоняя предложение старейшины.

d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Opt.en: Thank you for your generosity, but we have our own drum prepared.
d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Opt.cn: 多谢阁下厚意，我们已备好鼓具，便不劳烦了。
d055c3eb-e18f-48da-b38d-aac458703df5/Opt.ru: Спасибо вам за вашу щедрость, но у нас приготовлен наш собственный барабан.

f829e4df-a80a-49e5-8152-5ca31e341a10/Eve.en: "Very well! Then use your own drum!<NL>Let the moon and Butterfly Mother hear your beat!"<NL><NL>With that, the elder turns and walks back into the crowd.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>retrieves the Lion's Drum from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> belongings, and gently places the little creature upon the drumhead.<NL>Ran Xindu glances back at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, her feelers trembling ever so slightly—<NL>and in the next instant, the sound of drums resounds across the mountains and valleys...
f829e4df-a80a-49e5-8152-5ca31e341a10/Eve.cn: “得行！就拿你们自家呢鼓！<NL>让月亮、蝴蝶妈妈都听听你呢鼓声！”<NL><NL>老者说罢，转身步入人群，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>从行囊当中取出狮子战鼓，将掌中虫儿放至鼓面，<NL>苒心毒回身望了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一眼，而后触角微颤，<NL>霎时鼓声响起，传遍山川……

caf2509f-2164-41a0-8e7d-2afeae9afa2f/Eve.en: The drumbeat begins light and sprightly, like mountain sparrows chirping, like silver bells swaying in the breeze.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a gentle ripple in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> heart, and somehow senses Ran Xindu's thoughts—before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> knows it, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> is singing aloud:<NL><NL>"At the mouth of the Five Venoms Valley I met you, my heart cried like a thrush in bloom.<NL>Even butterflies loved your fragrant hair, circling thrice, longing for your smile to resume..."
caf2509f-2164-41a0-8e7d-2afeae9afa2f/Eve.cn: 初时鼓声轻快雀跃，如山雀鸣叫，银铃摇风，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽觉心湖微漾，竟而感知到苒心毒心中所想，不觉吟唱出声：<NL><NL>“五毒谷口遇你来，阿妹心似画眉叫，<NL>蝴蝶也恋你发梢，绕飞三匝盼你回眸笑……”

caf2509f-2164-41a0-8e7d-2afeae9afa2f/Opt.en: (Is this... the story of how I first met Ran Xindu...?)
caf2509f-2164-41a0-8e7d-2afeae9afa2f/Opt.cn: （这……唱得是我与苒心毒的初见么……）
caf2509f-2164-41a0-8e7d-2afeae9afa2f/Opt.ru: (Это так... история о том, как я впервые встретил Ран Синду...?)

051e562e-116b-4951-bd92-e7e49d2098f8/Eve.en: Suddenly, the drumbeat deepens, like clouds veiling the moon.<NL>All who hear it feel a faint constriction in their chest, as if unspoken sorrow is knocking gently at the heart:<NL><NL>"Silver moonlight chills my ailing frame, I'm leaving Miao lands for distant range.<NL>Through a thousand peaks I turn and gaze—Granny's rice liquor remains half-untasted."
051e562e-116b-4951-bd92-e7e49d2098f8/Eve.cn: 忽而鼓声渐沉，如云蔽月，<NL>闻者只觉心口微窒，似有说不清的愁绪叩入心房：<NL><NL>“银月照我病身寒，欲别苗乡赴远山，<NL>千岭万壑回头望，阿嬷的米酒还没喝完。”

051e562e-116b-4951-bd92-e7e49d2098f8/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu was afflicted by the Quintessence Heartbane. I vowed to Divine Matron that I would escort her to salvation...)
051e562e-116b-4951-bd92-e7e49d2098f8/Opt.cn: （苒心毒中了五圣心毒，我受圣姑所托，欲带她前往救治……）
051e562e-116b-4951-bd92-e7e49d2098f8/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду был поражен квинтэссенцией Сердечного приступа. Я поклялся Божественной Матроне, что сопровожу ее к спасению...)

459148ad-8c02-498c-a630-7afdc8b7306e/Eve.en: "With you beside me, hand in hand we roam,<NL>Through miasma-veiled paths, yet peace fills my soul—like Miao spring breeze so warm.<NL>We wander the world with our fates entwined, sharing all joys and pains in a single bowl,<NL>Facing danger side by side, blades flashing bright—only then I know Han folk, too, can love true and whole..."<NL><NL>Then, the beat begins to brighten,<NL>Like spring rain falling, like rivers rushing—instilling calm into every heart...
459148ad-8c02-498c-a630-7afdc8b7306e/Eve.cn: “幸得你在侧，牵衣伴我行，<NL>踏过瘴雾心也安，好似苗岭春风暖，<NL>携手同游天地宽，酒分苦辣同碗饮嘛，路见险恶共刀锋哎，<NL>才知汉人也有真心待……”<NL><NL>随即，鼓点渐转明快，<NL>似春风化雨，如溪流奔涌，令人心中安定……

459148ad-8c02-498c-a630-7afdc8b7306e/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu and I journeyed together, from Valley of Flowers to Mt. Kongsang...)
459148ad-8c02-498c-a630-7afdc8b7306e/Opt.cn: （苒心毒与我一同去百花、空桑，一路历经诸事……）
459148ad-8c02-498c-a630-7afdc8b7306e/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду и я путешествовали вместе, от Долины цветов до горы Кунсан...)

82a173ec-6015-4806-a039-faa3f4cd028b/Eve.en: "Alas... Beyond the green hills, beyond towers high, though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> is fair... still must <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> return..."<NL><NL>The drumbeat quickens, rising from calm to urgency, each strike laden with weight, with unspeakable grief:<NL>"Heard tell of Granny setting fire to the Divine Tree, blood spilled on pleated skirts from kin betrayed—how could my heart not break?<NL>Rather shattered bones in silent grave, than grief flooding the Miao stockade..."
82a173ec-6015-4806-a039-faa3f4cd028b/Eve.cn: “唉……山外青山楼外楼，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>虽好……终须还……”<NL><NL>继而鼓点由缓至急，声声催迫，似有千钧重压，无尽苦楚：<NL>“忽闻阿嬷焚神树嘛，百褶裙溅族人血嘛，教我如何不断肠哎，<NL>宁可碎骨埋洞葬嘛，不教哀伤流苗寨……”

82a173ec-6015-4806-a039-faa3f4cd028b/Opt.en: (Divine Matron schemed to make Ran Xindu master the Quintessence Heartbane at the cost of harming her own kin...)
82a173ec-6015-4806-a039-faa3f4cd028b/Opt.cn: （圣姑为令苒心毒练成五圣心毒，不惜设计伤害族人……）
82a173ec-6015-4806-a039-faa3f4cd028b/Opt.ru: (Божественная Матрона замыслила заставить Ран Синду овладеть Квинтэссенцией Губителя сердец ценой причинения вреда ее собственному роду...)

1606289d-d000-4bd2-b5b6-61b84f7c19d8/Eve.en: "Dong—dong—dong—"<NL>A few deep, solemn beats pierce the gloom, like dawn breaking through the dark...<NL>"Thanks to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> who brought the spring rain, soaking the thousand fields of the Miao hills,<NL>You righted the fallen sacred pillar, you polished the silver badge once dulled by dust,<NL>Now, with guests planting seedlings hand in hand, you and I share glutinous rice liquor..."
1606289d-d000-4bd2-b5b6-61b84f7c19d8/Eve.cn: “咚咚咚——”<NL>几声沉雄鼓响暗，宛若曙光破开黑暗……<NL><NL>“幸得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>携春雨来嘛，润透苗山万亩田，<NL>你扶起倒下的神柱嘛，你擦亮蒙尘的银牌哎，<NL>如今客来共插秧嘛，你我同饮糯米酒……”

1606289d-d000-4bd2-b5b6-61b84f7c19d8/Opt.en: (Now, with guests planting seedlings hand in hand, you and I share glutinous rice liquor...)
1606289d-d000-4bd2-b5b6-61b84f7c19d8/Opt.cn: （如今客来共插秧嘛，你我同饮糯米酒……）
1606289d-d000-4bd2-b5b6-61b84f7c19d8/Opt.ru: (Теперь, когда гости, взявшись за руки, высаживают рассаду, мы с вами пьем клейкий рисовый Вино...)

4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Eve.en: "Butterfly Mother beams with joy, rainbow light drapes over hill and vale,<NL>Ask not where our bloodline flows—true hearts all grow on the same vine!"<NL><NL>The final drumbeat falls, its echoes lingering long...
4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Eve.cn: “蝴蝶妈妈开怀笑嘛，千寨万岭披虹霞，<NL>莫问血脉何处来嘛，真心都是藤上瓜！”<NL><NL>最后一鼓落下，余韵绵长……
4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Eve.ru: "Мать-бабочка сияет от радости, радужный свет окутывает холмы и долины,<NL>Не спрашивай, откуда течет наша родословная — все истинные сердца растут на одной лозе!"<NL><NL>Затихает последний барабанный бой, его эхо еще долго отдается эхом...

4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Opt.en: (So this... is the tale of all that Ran Xindu and I have been through...)
4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Opt.cn: （这便是我与苒心毒所历诸事……）
4211a929-0101-4e2d-a2b2-76d16243e100/Opt.ru: (Итак, это... рассказ обо всем, через что прошли Ран Синду и я...)

58a191ef-6a77-4e7b-a8ab-d7edc25a7ff9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a swell of emotion and turns to look at Ran Xindu.<NL>Just then, she turns and glances back—their eyes meet, and something stirs in her heart. She continues, softly:<NL><NL>"Yet now I've turned to worm, cast into the Gu jar... no longer may we roam the Ninefold Skies, hand in hand..."
58a191ef-6a77-4e7b-a8ab-d7edc25a7ff9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时心潮起伏，不禁望向苒心毒，<NL>恰她转身回眸，二人眸光一触，苒心毒心中一动，又再续道：<NL><NL>“却化虫儿落蛊坛……再难携手游九垓……”

58a191ef-6a77-4e7b-a8ab-d7edc25a7ff9/Opt.en: "Yet now she's turned to worm, cast into the Gu jar... no longer may we roam the Ninefold Skies, hand in hand..."
58a191ef-6a77-4e7b-a8ab-d7edc25a7ff9/Opt.cn: 却化虫儿落蛊坛……再难携手游九垓……
58a191ef-6a77-4e7b-a8ab-d7edc25a7ff9/Opt.ru: - Но теперь она превратилась в червяка, брошенного в банку с Гу... мы больше не сможем странствовать по Девятикратным небесам, взявшись за руки..."

3d6148dc-cca8-4ce0-ab2a-25433faa8588/Eve.en: The drumming slowly fades,<NL>but its echoes still linger through the valley—many among the Miao now weep with eyes full of tears...<NL>"Look there! On the drum—there really is a little worm..."<NL>"Could it be the drum we heard was beaten by this tiny creature? She... she became a worm to save us..."<NL>"The girl's drumming moved my heart—it couldn't have been faked... I really want to help her..."<NL><NL>Several Miao women have wiped their tears, their silver ornaments trembling with quiet sobs. Among the crowd, an elder sighs:<NL>"Even outsiders can have kind hearts..."
3d6148dc-cca8-4ce0-ab2a-25433faa8588/Eve.cn: 鼓声渐歇，<NL>山谷间余韵未绝，不少苗人已是眼含热泪……<NL>“你们瞧！那个鼓上，真呢有只小虫……”<NL>“难不成刚刚呢鼓是这个虫儿敲呢，她……为救族人变成了虫儿……”<NL>“阿妹呢鼓声好感人，绝对做不了假……我好想帮帮她……”<NL><NL>几名苗女已拭起眼角，银饰随抽泣轻颤，人群中更有苗族老者叹道：<NL>“外族人也有好心肠阿……”

3d6148dc-cca8-4ce0-ab2a-25433faa8588/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu spoke through her drum, and at last, their hearts were stirred...)
3d6148dc-cca8-4ce0-ab2a-25433faa8588/Opt.cn: （苒心毒以鼓传情，终是打动众人……）
3d6148dc-cca8-4ce0-ab2a-25433faa8588/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду заговорила через свой барабан, и, наконец, их сердца дрогнули...)

d7c8fa01-2bdb-49b5-9b7c-283df9181d7b/Eve.en: Suddenly,<NL>an elderly Miao woman in full ceremonial dress, her hair adorned with a silver comb, moves forward with trembling steps.<NL>Facing the ritual drum, she slowly raises both hands high above her head. The crowd falls into complete silence—<NL>only her devout song echoes through the mountain valley:<NL><NL>"O ancient Maple Spirit, birthplace of Butterfly Mother,<NL>open your eyes, I beg of you, and behold this girl, whose soul shines purer than jade itself!"
d7c8fa01-2bdb-49b5-9b7c-283df9181d7b/Eve.cn: 忽而这时，<NL>一位身着盛装、发插银梳的苗族老妪颤巍巍走出，<NL>只见她面向祭鼓，双手高举过头，场中一时寂然无声，<NL>只闻她虔诚的歌声遍传山谷：<NL><NL>“古老的枫树神啊，您是蝴蝶妈妈诞生的地方，<NL>请您睁开眼，看看这个灵魂比玉石更纯净的阿妹吧！”

d7c8fa01-2bdb-49b5-9b7c-283df9181d7b/Opt.en: Is she... praying for Ran Xindu?
d7c8fa01-2bdb-49b5-9b7c-283df9181d7b/Opt.cn: 她是在为苒心毒祈祷嘛……

9e57be2e-f23e-4036-8a6a-95b00d098a49/Eve.en: Whispers ripple through the crowd as more join their hands in prayer.<NL>A Miao woman removes her silver necklace and lays it before the ritual drum, murmuring:<NL>"Bless her, ancestral spirits—may this kind soul stay in human form and walk the Fortune Bridge with her beloved..."<NL><NL>Moved by her gesture, others follow, placing silver bangles and combs before the drum with soft prayers.<NL>Amid the rising tide of wishes, the small creature atop the drum trembles—<NL>a shimmer on her feelers, perhaps a tear... or morning dew...
9e57be2e-f23e-4036-8a6a-95b00d098a49/Eve.cn: 人群中低语渐起，越来越多的人合十祈祷，<NL>一名苗家女子解下项间银饰，轻轻置于祭鼓之前，低声祝念：<NL>“先祖神灵保佑，让这位善良呢阿妹能永远保持人形，与心上人携手走过风雨桥……”<NL><NL>四下苗人纷纷动容，皆解下银镯、银梳等贴身之物，置于祭鼓之前，喃喃祈祷，<NL>如潮的祈愿声中，静静伏于鼓面的虫儿微微颤动，触角之上一点晶莹，<NL>不知是泪，还是露水……

f1215c11-c712-472f-88b1-f3d707378047/Eve.en: A sudden gust of night wind sets the maple leaves rustling by the drum grounds, like a thousand butterflies taking flight.<NL>Then, streams of radiant light pour in from the eighteen villages, converging like rivulets into a sea, swirling around the Lion's Drum.<NL><NL>As the glow pulses and turns, a small figure within begins to stretch and shift...<NL>It's unclear how much time has passed when the lights finally scatter—and there she stands, a barefoot girl poised atop the drum, the silver bells at her ankles chiming softly.<NL>She lifts her gaze toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, a flush rising to her cheeks, eyes gleaming with emotion: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>..."
f1215c11-c712-472f-88b1-f3d707378047/Eve.cn: 夜风骤起，鼓场旁的枫树叶沙沙作响，仿佛万千蝴蝶振翅，<NL>忽而，道道灵光自十八寨而来，如涓流汇海，萦绕狮子战鼓四周，<NL><NL>光晕流转间，其中有一小小的身影渐渐舒展、变化……<NL>不知过了多久，灵光飞散，但见一名赤足少女婷婷立于鼓面，踝间银铃轻响，<NL>少女抬首望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，颊泛红霞，眼波流转：“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>……”

f1215c11-c712-472f-88b1-f3d707378047/Opt.en: Xindu... she truly is the Butterfly Mother... The Maple Tree... it really holds a Spirit...
f1215c11-c712-472f-88b1-f3d707378047/Opt.cn: 心毒……果真蝴蝶妈妈……枫树……有灵……
f1215c11-c712-472f-88b1-f3d707378047/Opt.ru: Синду... она действительно Мать-бабочка... Клен... в нем действительно есть Дух...

6229c130-f681-4cda-96e6-5401c45d408b/Eve.en: Ran Xindu leaps down from the drum, throwing herself into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s arms:<NL>"It's you, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>... and the prayers of our people...<NL>You moved the Butterfly Mother... the Spirit of the Maple Tree... you reached the Ancestors..."<NL><NL>Her voice catches. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a damp warmth spread across <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> chest—and something stirs within...
6229c130-f681-4cda-96e6-5401c45d408b/Eve.cn: 苒心毒闻言跃下鼓面，一头扑入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>怀中：<NL>“是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>……是族人呢祈祷，<NL>感动了蝴蝶妈妈……枫树神灵……感动了先祖……”<NL><NL>苒心毒音声微滞，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>觉得胸前湿润，不由心中一动……

6229c130-f681-4cda-96e6-5401c45d408b/Opt.en: (Gently strokes Ran Xindu...) This is more than I could ever hope for.
6229c130-f681-4cda-96e6-5401c45d408b/Opt.ru: (Нежно гладит Ран Синду...) Это больше, чем я когда-либо мог надеяться.

266dc13e-df09-446e-92a4-2fae639cd58c/Eve.en: "Butterfly Mother has shown Herself! She has heard our voices!"<NL>The cry rises as one, and the drum ground erupts in thunderous joy. Miao youths cheer and embrace, their voices rocking the mountain ridges...<NL><NL>At that moment, someone sounds the first note of the reed pipe.<NL>Like a call to arms, the melody sweeps through the crowd. Song and dance break forth as people form ring upon ring of circles.<NL>A few Miao maidens exchange smiles and step forward, clasping Ran Xindu's hand together with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s,<NL>leading them into the heart of the dance. Within the swirling throng, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> beholds Ran Xindu's skirt whirl like drifting clouds of color...
266dc13e-df09-446e-92a4-2fae639cd58c/Eve.cn: “蝴蝶妈妈显灵咯！祂听见我们的声音了！”<NL>呼声一起，鼓场顿时欢声雷动，苗家少年少女们喜极相庆，声震苗岭……<NL><NL>正当此时，不知谁人吹响了第一声芦笙，<NL>乐音宛如号令，众人和歌起舞，围成层层圆阵，<NL>几位苗家姑娘相视一笑，率先上前，将苒心毒和<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的手牵到一处，<NL>迎入舞阵中央，人群之中，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>但见苒心毒裙摆飞旋，宛若彩霞……

a34fb09b-efd7-4e9e-b04d-d8343bf0f4f5/Eve.en: The singing flows with the chiming of silver bells, washing across the Miao ridges...<NL><NL>At last, the moon leans westward, the bonfires fade, and the crowd slowly stills.<NL>A Miao elder parts the people and steps forward, coming to a halt before Ran Xindu.<NL>Into her palm he places a silver medallion engraved with a human face and the wings of a butterfly, his voice deep and gentle:<NL>"Good lass, this ancient Butterfly Mother's Silver now belongs to the true Drum Champion. May Butterfly Mother watch over you always..."
a34fb09b-efd7-4e9e-b04d-d8343bf0f4f5/Eve.cn: 歌声伴着银铃，洒满苗岭……<NL><NL>直至月轮西斜，篝火渐黯，人群渐静，<NL>苗族老者排开人群，缓步走至苒心毒身前，<NL>将一面镌刻着人面蝴蝶的银牌放入苒心毒掌心，声音浑厚，语带慈祥：<NL>“小阿妹，这面蝶母古银，属于真正的鼓王了，愿蝴蝶妈妈永远护佑着你……”

51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Eve.en: Ran Xindu's eyes light up, then cloud with a trace of uncertainty. She murmurs softly:<NL>"But I didn't play anything grand...<NL>I only beat out what my heart could no longer keep inside... Am I truly the Drum Champion?"
51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Eve.cn: 苒心毒眼眸一亮，随即又浮起几分茫然，喃喃道：<NL>“可我敲的不是什么了不得的曲调，只是……<NL>只是我心里藏不住的情意……我真呢是鼓王嘛？”
51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Eve.ru: Глаза Ран Синду загораются, затем затуманиваются тенью неуверенности. Она тихо бормочет:<NL>- Но я не играл ничего грандиозного...<NL>Я выбивал только то, что мое сердце больше не могло держать внутри... Я действительно чемпион по игре на барабанах?"

51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Opt.en: (With her heart carried upon the drum, Ran Xindu moved all who heard her. The title of Drum Champion is hers in truth...)
51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Opt.cn: （苒心毒以鼓传情，感人动心，鼓王之名，实至名归……）
51937c18-a127-43ed-ba2d-982c8c5a121a/Opt.ru: (Своим сердцем, бьющим в барабан, Ран Синду тронула всех, кто ее слышал. По правде говоря, титул чемпионки по игре на барабанах принадлежит ей...)

89a6f018-58b8-444f-8b6f-694e7430c88a/Eve.en: "Your drumming is filled with feeling—we all can hear it in every beat..."<NL>"That's right! Sister, your drums brought tears to our eyes. How could you not be worthy of the name Drum Champion?"<NL><NL>The Miao voices rise around her in answer...<NL>The elder laughs aloud and gives Ran Xindu's shoulder a gentle pat:<NL>"And more than that, in your drumming we also hear it plain—no matter where one's bloodline comes from, true hearts all grow from the same vine."
89a6f018-58b8-444f-8b6f-694e7430c88a/Eve.cn: “你呢鼓声装着满满呢情，我们都感受呢到……”<NL>“说得是！阿姐的鼓声让我们都落了泪，怎会当不起这鼓王之名？”<NL><NL>周围苗人纷纷出言回道……<NL>那老者也朗声大笑，轻轻拍了拍苒心毒肩膀：<NL>“而且，从你呢鼓声当中，我们也晓得了莫问血脉何处来嘛，真心都是藤上瓜！”

cc5c7fff-9be4-4c04-b54a-b95648f844b6/Eve.en: "All right then—go share a cup of rice liquor with the one you hold dear.<NL>Do not waste the fine moonlight the Butterfly Mother has granted you!"<NL><NL>With that, the elder strokes his beard and laughs aloud, casting the two of them a knowing glance before turning away.<NL>When he has gone, Ran Xindu finally turns and presses the silver medallion into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s palm...
cc5c7fff-9be4-4c04-b54a-b95648f844b6/Eve.cn: “好咯，快些去和你呢心上人喝杯米酒罢，<NL>莫要辜负了蝴蝶妈妈赐的好月光！”<NL><NL>说及此处，老者捻须朗笑，意味深长地看了二人一眼，便即转身离去，<NL>待老者走远，苒心毒方才转身，将手中银牌塞进<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>掌心……

cc5c7fff-9be4-4c04-b54a-b95648f844b6/Opt.en: This is the prize of the Drum Champion—why are you giving it to me...?
cc5c7fff-9be4-4c04-b54a-b95648f844b6/Opt.cn: 这是你鼓王的彩头，怎地给我了……
cc5c7fff-9be4-4c04-b54a-b95648f844b6/Opt.ru: Это приз чемпиона по игре на барабанах — почему ты отдаешь его мне...?

f1b34b8a-219a-469c-bd8e-ccf40d52cb10/Eve.en: Ran Xindu folds her arms, lifts her chin slightly, and turns away on purpose:<NL>"Hmph... I've got seven or eight of these silver tags piled up in my bamboo basket... what's so special about this one..."<NL><NL>Yet <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels something stir within and hears what Ran Xindu truly means in her heart:<NL>"You dummy, the ancient Butterfly Mother's Silver wards off ill and keeps one safe. I want you in peace every day, every year,<NL>to walk the eighteen Miao villages with me and watch the colored clouds drift by..."
f1b34b8a-219a-469c-bd8e-ccf40d52cb10/Eve.cn: 苒心毒双手抱臂，下巴微扬，故意侧过身去：<NL>“哼……这种银牌我竹筐里堆着七八块哩……有什么稀罕的……”<NL><NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心念微动，已然听得苒心毒心中所想：<NL>“傻<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，蝶母古银能辟邪护身，我要你日日平安，年年平安，<NL>和我一起走遍十八寨，看尽彩云飞……”

f1b34b8a-219a-469c-bd8e-ccf40d52cb10/Opt.en: So that's why you fought so hard for the title... just to give me the silver medallion. (Xindu... I will stay safe, always...)
f1b34b8a-219a-469c-bd8e-ccf40d52cb10/Opt.cn: 原来你是为了送我银牌，方才争夺鼓王。（心毒……我定会平平安安……）
f1b34b8a-219a-469c-bd8e-ccf40d52cb10/Opt.ru: Так вот почему вы так упорно боролись за титул... просто чтобы отдать мне серебряный медальон. (Синду... Я всегда буду в безопасности...)

d717b4c8-f06e-4673-95c8-b96a3cfad7f7/Eve.en: Dew glistens in the morning sun as the clamor fades away.<NL>People trade farewells, their laughter and the chime of silver bells<NL>slowly dissolving into the mist-wound mountain paths...<NL><NL>Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is about to leave with Ran Xindu, a faint sound breaks the calm.<NL>The Lion's Drum in her arms gives a gentle shiver, and from its surface rolls a tiny creature, clear as carved jade.<NL>The little insect shakes its wings and lets out a bell-like chime...
d717b4c8-f06e-4673-95c8-b96a3cfad7f7/Eve.cn: 露湛朝阳，喧嚣渐息，<NL>众人互相道别，笑语欢声与叮当银铃之声，<NL>渐渐散入了云雾缭绕的山道之中……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正欲与苒心毒离去，忽闻一声轻响，<NL>却见苒心毒怀中的狮子战鼓鼓面微颤，竟从其中滚出一只剔透如玉的小虫，<NL>那虫儿抖了抖翅膀，发出铃铛般的轻鸣……

7bf50a45-0ddb-4327-b581-57ed7e74a40e/Eve.en: Ran Xindu gives a little cry and reaches out to hide it, but it is already too late. She can only explain:<NL><NL>"Ah, fine, fine—you've seen it now... I'll tell you the truth. This is a Ringing Bug.<NL>It makes sounds travel far. When it perches by someone's ear, every little whisper will be carried through the valleys..."
7bf50a45-0ddb-4327-b581-57ed7e74a40e/Eve.cn: 苒心毒“呀”了一声，伸手欲藏却已来不及，只得解释道：<NL><NL>“算啦算啦，都被你瞧见咯……告诉你好啦，这是响声虫，<NL>可以放大声音，它趴在谁耳边，谁呢悄悄话就要被传遍山坳坳……”

7bf50a45-0ddb-4327-b581-57ed7e74a40e/Opt.en: So you used the Lion's Drum because you were afraid the little bug would chew through the drumskin again...
7bf50a45-0ddb-4327-b581-57ed7e74a40e/Opt.cn: 所以你用狮子战鼓，是怕蛊虫又咬破鼓皮……
7bf50a45-0ddb-4327-b581-57ed7e74a40e/Opt.ru: Итак, вы использовали Львиный барабан, потому что боялись, что маленький жучок снова прогрызет барабанную перепонку...

f4dba7a1-1f11-4976-8f77-c81042823c49/Eve.en: "At first... I was thinking... if my drumming wasn't loud enough,<NL>then I'd let it carry my sound through all eighteen Miao villages and win the name of Drum Champion that way..."<NL><NL>Her voice trails off as she steals a glance at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, then she straightens up at once and declares with mock dignity:<NL>"But now I'm the Drum Champion fair and square! I won with my true feelings, not because my drums were loud!"
f4dba7a1-1f11-4976-8f77-c81042823c49/Eve.cn: “本来……我是想着……要是鼓声不够响，<NL>就靠它把声音传遍十八寨，争一争这鼓王呢名号……”<NL><NL>她话音渐低，偷偷瞥了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一眼，随即又挺直腰板，理直气壮道：<NL>“不过现在我可是堂堂正正呢鼓王，靠呢是我呢真情实意，可不是因为声音大！”

f4dba7a1-1f11-4976-8f77-c81042823c49/Opt.en: You carried your heart upon the drum and moved everyone who heard you. You truly are the Drum Champion.
f4dba7a1-1f11-4976-8f77-c81042823c49/Opt.cn: 你以鼓传情，打动众人，确是堂堂正正的鼓王。
f4dba7a1-1f11-4976-8f77-c81042823c49/Opt.ru: Ты била сердцем в барабан и тронула всех, кто тебя слышал. Ты действительно чемпион по игре на барабанах.

500ac3f4-3bcd-471b-a38b-fe9949017fd9/Eve.en: "Of course!"<NL><NL>Ran Xindu's eyes curve into a bright,<NL>proud smile as she grabs <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> by the wrist and tugs <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> forward:<NL>"Come on, come on—let's head home from here and tell all eighteen villages about my Drum Champion title!"
500ac3f4-3bcd-471b-a38b-fe9949017fd9/Eve.cn: “那是当然！”<NL><NL>苒心毒眉眼弯弯，得意非凡，<NL>一把拉住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手腕，雀跃前行：<NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>快走快走，我们从这跌回家，将我呢鼓王名号一路传遍十八寨！”
500ac3f4-3bcd-471b-a38b-fe9949017fd9/Eve.ru: "Конечно!"<NL><NL>Глаза Ран Синду искривились в ярком,<NL>гордая улыбка, когда она хватает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> за запястье и дергает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> вперед:<NL>"Давай, давай — давай отправимся отсюда домой и расскажем всем восемнадцати деревням о моем титуле чемпиона по игре на барабанах!"

2c86fbd8-69aa-40f2-9960-0952b845fe37/Eve.en: Just then, a Miao elder in ceremonial dress steps forward to stand before Ran Xindu,<NL>his gaze gentle as it settles upon her:<NL><NL>"Good lass, the heart of the drum is torn, yet the mountain wind still blows, and the moon still hangs high.<NL>Will you go on drumming?"
2c86fbd8-69aa-40f2-9960-0952b845fe37/Eve.cn: 这时，一位身着盛装的苗族老者缓步行至苒心毒身前，<NL>目光温和地落于苒心毒身上：<NL><NL>“阿妹，鼓心破了，但山风没停，月亮还在天上，<NL>你各还要继续敲鼓呢？”
2c86fbd8-69aa-40f2-9960-0952b845fe37/Eve.ru: Как раз в этот момент старейшина Мяо в церемониальной одежде выходит вперед и встает перед Ран Синду,<NL>его нежный взгляд останавливается на ней:<NL><NL>- Хорошая девочка, сердце барабана разорвано, но горный ветер все еще дует, и луна все еще висит высоко.<NL>Ты будешь продолжать играть на барабанах?"

1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Eve.en: Ran Xindu stands tall, her eyes shining bright—<NL>as though she has grasped the meaning behind <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s words.<NL><NL>"I'll keep drumming!<NL>Even if I never earn the title of Drum Champion, I'll still drum out what's in my heart—for everyone to hear..."
1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Eve.cn: 但见苒心毒昂首挺胸，双目清亮，<NL>似是已然想通<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>言中之意……<NL><NL>“阿耶，我要继续敲鼓，<NL>就算拿不着鼓王，我也要把我心头想呢，敲给大家听……”
1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Eve.ru: Ран Синду стоит во весь рост, ее глаза ярко сияют—<NL>как будто она уловила смысл, стоящий за этим <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>его слова.<NL><NL>- Я буду продолжать барабанить!<NL>Даже если я никогда не заслужу титул чемпиона по игре на барабанах, я все равно буду выбивать то, что у меня на сердце — чтобы все услышали..."

1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Opt.en: (Then strike the drum, and let your heart be heard!)
1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Opt.cn: （好，便将你心中所想，敲给大家听。）
1cf4b35f-5ac9-4f67-ad5f-e1a13ff5183a/Opt.ru: (Тогда ударь в барабан, и пусть твое сердце будет услышано!)

9d643f77-e322-4297-9c0c-85c22f50618e/Eve.en: "Well said, lass! You've got that Miao spirit in you!"<NL>The elder lets out a hearty laugh, his face full of praise. With a wave of his hand, he says:<NL>"Still, your drumhead's broken. Let me fetch you a new one!"<NL><NL>"No need!" Before his words have fully fallen, Ran Xindu turns to<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and says:<NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>, isn't there a drum in your belongings? Just use that one!<NL>The hide on it is thick—it's a good drum!"
9d643f77-e322-4297-9c0c-85c22f50618e/Eve.cn: “好阿妹，这才是我们苗人！”<NL>老者闻言朗声大笑，面露赞许之色，随即挥手道：<NL>“不过你们呢鼓心破啦，我给你们换面新鼓！”<NL><NL>“不消啦！”老者话音未落，苒心毒转向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>道：<NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>，你呢行囊不是有一面鼓嘛，用那个鼓就好啦！<NL>那个鼓皮儿厚，是面好鼓哩！”

9d643f77-e322-4297-9c0c-85c22f50618e/Opt.en: Drum... you mean the Lion's Drum?
9d643f77-e322-4297-9c0c-85c22f50618e/Opt.ru: Барабан... ты имеешь в виду Львиный барабан?

cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Eve.en: Ran Xindu keeps nodding eagerly.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> picks up on the cue and gives a knowing nod, then promptly cups <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> hands in salute, politely declining the elder's offer.
cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Eve.cn: 苒心毒不住点头，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>会意颔首，当即向老者拱手推辞……
cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Eve.ru: Ран Синду продолжает нетерпеливо кивать.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> улавливает намек и понимающе кивает, затем быстро выпивает <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> поднимаю руки в приветствии, вежливо отклоняя предложение старейшины.

cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Opt.en: Thank you for your generosity, but we have our own drum prepared.
cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Opt.cn: 多谢阁下厚意，我们已备好鼓具，便不劳烦了。
cf9d3b1a-d2f4-4aae-b8da-cbfd3bc32218/Opt.ru: Спасибо вам за вашу щедрость, но у нас приготовлен наш собственный барабан.

d5f6e60b-1ea9-4047-b782-dae34dd96de7/Eve.en: "Very well! Then use your own drum!<NL>Let the moon and Butterfly Mother hear your beat!"<NL><NL>With that, the elder turns and walks back into the crowd.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>retrieves the Lion's Drum from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> travel bag, and gently places the little creature upon the drumhead.<NL>Ran Xindu glances back at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, her feelers trembling ever so slightly—<NL>and in the next instant, the sound of drums resounds across the mountains and valleys...
d5f6e60b-1ea9-4047-b782-dae34dd96de7/Eve.cn: “得行！就拿你们自家鼓！<NL>让月亮、蝴蝶妈妈都听听我们阿妹呢鼓声！”<NL><NL>老者说罢，转身步入人群，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>从行囊当中取出狮子战鼓交予苒心毒，<NL>苒心毒回身望了<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一眼，而后执槌击鼓，霎时鼓声响起，传遍山川……

2d7e1bd4-162f-486c-830e-33b0903df063/Eve.en: The drumbeat begins light and sprightly, like mountain sparrows chirping, like silver bells swaying in the breeze.<NL>Keeping time with the rhythm, Ran Xindu hums in a soft Miao tune:<NL><NL>"At the mouth of the Five Venoms Valley I met you, my heart cried like a thrush in bloom.<NL>Even butterflies loved your fragrant hair, circling thrice, longing for your smile to resume..."
2d7e1bd4-162f-486c-830e-33b0903df063/Eve.cn: 初时鼓声轻快雀跃，如山雀鸣叫，银铃摇风，<NL>苒心毒和着节拍，口中哼起软糯的苗歌：<NL><NL>“五毒谷口遇你来，阿妹心似画眉叫，<NL>蝴蝶也恋你发梢，绕飞三匝盼你回眸笑……”

2d7e1bd4-162f-486c-830e-33b0903df063/Opt.en: (Is this... the story of how I first met Ran Xindu...?)
2d7e1bd4-162f-486c-830e-33b0903df063/Opt.cn: （这……唱得是我与苒心毒的初见么……）
2d7e1bd4-162f-486c-830e-33b0903df063/Opt.ru: (Это так... история о том, как я впервые встретил Ран Синду...?)

dd033f18-89ef-48ea-b206-624f80795d83/Eve.en: Suddenly, the drumbeat deepens, like clouds veiling the moon.<NL>All who hear it feel a faint constriction in their chest, as if unspoken sorrow is knocking gently at the heart:<NL><NL>"Silver moonlight chills my ailing frame, I'm leaving Miao lands for distant range.<NL>Through a thousand peaks I turn and gaze—Granny's rice liquor remains half-untasted."
dd033f18-89ef-48ea-b206-624f80795d83/Eve.cn: 忽而鼓声渐沉，如云蔽月，<NL>闻者只觉心口微窒，似有说不清的愁绪叩入心房：<NL><NL>“银月照我病身寒，欲别苗乡赴远山，<NL>千岭万壑回头望，阿嬷的米酒还没喝完。”

dd033f18-89ef-48ea-b206-624f80795d83/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu was afflicted by the Quintessence Heartbane. I vowed to Divine Matron that I would escort her to salvation...)
dd033f18-89ef-48ea-b206-624f80795d83/Opt.cn: （苒心毒中了五圣心毒，我受圣姑所托，欲带她前往救治……）
dd033f18-89ef-48ea-b206-624f80795d83/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду был поражен квинтэссенцией Сердечного приступа. Я поклялся Божественной Матроне, что сопровожу ее к спасению...)

a0487f7f-b558-4612-a17d-52cb31cf95fe/Eve.en: "With you beside me, hand in hand we roam,<NL>Through miasma-veiled paths, yet peace fills my soul—like Miao spring breeze so warm.<NL>We wander the world with our fates entwined, sharing all joys and pains in a single bowl,<NL>Facing danger side by side, blades flashing bright—only then I know Han folk, too, can love true and whole..."<NL><NL>Then, the beat begins to brighten,<NL>Like spring rain falling, like rivers rushing—instilling calm into every heart...
a0487f7f-b558-4612-a17d-52cb31cf95fe/Eve.cn: “幸得你在侧，牵衣伴我行，<NL>踏过瘴雾心也安，好似苗岭春风暖，<NL>携手同游天地宽，酒分苦辣同碗饮嘛，路见险恶共刀锋哎，<NL>才知汉人也有真心待……”<NL><NL>随即，鼓点渐转明快，<NL>似春风化雨，如溪流奔涌，令人心中安定……

a0487f7f-b558-4612-a17d-52cb31cf95fe/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu and I journeyed together, from Valley of Flowers to Mt. Kongsang...)
a0487f7f-b558-4612-a17d-52cb31cf95fe/Opt.cn: （苒心毒与我一同去百花、空桑，一路历经诸事……）
a0487f7f-b558-4612-a17d-52cb31cf95fe/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду и я путешествовали вместе, от Долины цветов до горы Кунсан...)

5f2036f5-26ad-40b9-ac03-3549d5c7e7c0/Eve.en: "Alas... Beyond the green hills, beyond towers high, though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> is fair... still must <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> return..."<NL><NL>The drumbeat quickens, rising from calm to urgency, each strike laden with weight, with unspeakable grief:<NL>"Heard tell of Granny setting fire to the Divine Tree, blood spilled on pleated skirts from kin betrayed—how could my heart not break?<NL>Rather shattered bones in silent grave, than grief flooding the Miao stockade..."
5f2036f5-26ad-40b9-ac03-3549d5c7e7c0/Eve.cn: “唉……山外青山楼外楼，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>虽好……终须还……”<NL><NL>继而鼓点由缓至急，声声催迫，似有千钧重压，无尽苦楚：<NL>“忽闻阿嬷焚神树嘛，百褶裙溅族人血嘛，教我如何不断肠哎，<NL>宁可碎骨埋洞葬嘛，不教哀伤流苗寨……”

5f2036f5-26ad-40b9-ac03-3549d5c7e7c0/Opt.en: (Divine Matron schemed to make Ran Xindu master the Quintessence Heartbane at the cost of harming her own kin...)
5f2036f5-26ad-40b9-ac03-3549d5c7e7c0/Opt.cn: （圣姑为令苒心毒练成五圣心毒，不惜设计伤害族人……）
5f2036f5-26ad-40b9-ac03-3549d5c7e7c0/Opt.ru: (Божественная Матрона замыслила заставить Ран Синду овладеть Квинтэссенцией Губителя сердец ценой причинения вреда ее собственному роду...)

f35225c4-6261-42e6-a4c1-a706f23349dc/Eve.en: "Dong—dong—dong—"<NL>A few deep, solemn beats pierce the gloom, like dawn breaking through the dark...<NL><NL>"Thanks to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> who brought the spring rain, soaking the thousand fields of the Miao hills,<NL>You righted the fallen sacred pillar, you polished the silver badge once dulled by dust,<NL>Now, with guests planting seedlings hand in hand, you and I share glutinous rice liquor..."
f35225c4-6261-42e6-a4c1-a706f23349dc/Eve.cn: “咚咚咚——”<NL>几声沉雄鼓响，宛如曙光破开黑暗……<NL><NL>“幸得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>携春雨来嘛，润透苗山万亩田，<NL>你扶起倒下的神柱嘛，你擦亮蒙尘的银牌哎，<NL>如今客来共插秧嘛，你我同饮糯米酒……”

f35225c4-6261-42e6-a4c1-a706f23349dc/Opt.en: (Now, with guests planting seedlings hand in hand, you and I share glutinous rice liquor...)
f35225c4-6261-42e6-a4c1-a706f23349dc/Opt.cn: （如今客来共插秧嘛，你我同饮糯米酒……）
f35225c4-6261-42e6-a4c1-a706f23349dc/Opt.ru: (Теперь, когда гости, взявшись за руки, высаживают рассаду, мы с вами пьем клейкий рисовый Вино...)

be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Eve.en: "Butterfly Mother beams with joy, rainbow light drapes over hill and vale,<NL>Ask not where our bloodline flows—true hearts all grow on the same vine!"<NL><NL>The final drumbeat falls, its echoes lingering long...
be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Eve.cn: “蝴蝶妈妈开怀笑嘛，千寨万岭披虹霞，<NL>莫问血脉何处来嘛，真心都是藤上瓜！”<NL><NL>最后一鼓落下，余韵绵长……
be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Eve.ru: "Мать-бабочка сияет от радости, радужный свет окутывает холмы и долины,<NL>Не спрашивай, откуда течет наша родословная — все истинные сердца растут на одной лозе!"<NL><NL>Затихает последний барабанный бой, его эхо еще долго отдается эхом...

be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Opt.en: (So this... is the tale of all that Ran Xindu and I have been through...)
be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Opt.cn: （这便是我与苒心毒所历诸事……）
be3c8cdc-2e13-4b19-aa07-2745dd7e26d8/Opt.ru: (Итак, это... рассказ обо всем, через что прошли Ран Синду и я...)

d78514f6-a7fe-4bd9-8c43-541ee7d7534f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a swell of emotion and turns to look at Ran Xindu.<NL>Just then, she turns and glances back—their eyes meet, and something stirs in her heart. She continues, softly:<NL><NL>"Yet there will be a day... I'll turn to worm again, cast into the Gu jar... no longer may we roam the Ninefold Skies, hand in hand..."
d78514f6-a7fe-4bd9-8c43-541ee7d7534f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一时心潮起伏，不禁望向苒心毒，<NL>恰她转身回眸，二人眸光一触，苒心毒心中一动，又再续道：<NL><NL>“不知何时……却又化虫儿落蛊坛～再难携手游九垓……”

d78514f6-a7fe-4bd9-8c43-541ee7d7534f/Opt.en: (Yet there will be a day... she'll turn to worm again, cast into the Gu jar... no longer may we roam the Ninefold Skies, hand in hand...) Ran Xindu...
d78514f6-a7fe-4bd9-8c43-541ee7d7534f/Opt.cn: （不知何时……却又化虫儿落蛊坛～再难携手游九垓……）苒心毒……
d78514f6-a7fe-4bd9-8c43-541ee7d7534f/Opt.ru: (И все же настанет день... она снова превратится в червяка, брошенного в банку с Гу... мы больше не сможем странствовать по Девятикратным небесам, рука об руку...) Ран Синду...

7fb8e96c-f133-4a27-9a6a-eccfe66ad399/Eve.en: The drumming slowly fades,<NL>but its echoes still linger through the valley—many among the Miao now weep with eyes full of tears...<NL>"Will our sister truly turn into a little bug? For us, must she never walk hand in hand forever with the one she loves...?"<NL>"The girl's drumming moved my heart—it couldn't have been faked... I really want to help her..."<NL><NL>Several Miao women have wiped their tears, their silver ornaments trembling with quiet sobs. Among the crowd, an elder sighs:<NL>"Even outsiders can have kind hearts..."
7fb8e96c-f133-4a27-9a6a-eccfe66ad399/Eve.cn: 鼓声渐歇，<NL>山谷间余韵未绝，不少苗人已是眼含热泪……<NL>“阿妹还会化作虫儿么，她为了苗人，不能同心上人永永远远携手……”<NL>“阿妹呢鼓声好感人，绝对做不了假……我好想帮帮她……”<NL><NL>几名苗女已拭起眼角，银饰随抽泣轻颤，人群中更有苗族老者叹道：<NL>“外族人也有好心肠阿……”

7fb8e96c-f133-4a27-9a6a-eccfe66ad399/Opt.en: (Ran Xindu spoke through her drum, and at last, their hearts were stirred...)
7fb8e96c-f133-4a27-9a6a-eccfe66ad399/Opt.cn: （苒心毒以鼓传情，终是打动众人……）
7fb8e96c-f133-4a27-9a6a-eccfe66ad399/Opt.ru: (Ран Синду заговорила через свой барабан, и, наконец, их сердца дрогнули...)

74ecf92c-96ed-46fb-b795-22eb281320f1/Eve.en: Suddenly,<NL>an elderly Miao woman in full ceremonial dress, her hair adorned with a silver comb, moves forward with trembling steps.<NL>Facing the ritual drum, she slowly raises both hands high above her head. The crowd falls into complete silence—<NL>only her devout song echoes through the mountain valley:<NL><NL>"O ancient Maple Spirit, birthplace of Butterfly Mother,<NL>open your eyes, I beg of you, and behold this girl, whose soul shines purer than jade itself!"
74ecf92c-96ed-46fb-b795-22eb281320f1/Eve.cn: 忽而这时，<NL>一位身着盛装、发插银梳的苗族老妪颤巍巍走出，<NL>只见她面向祭鼓，双手高举过头，场中一时寂然无声，<NL>只闻她虔诚的歌声遍传山谷：<NL><NL>“古老的枫树神啊，您是蝴蝶妈妈诞生的地方，<NL>请您睁开眼，看看这个灵魂比玉石更纯净的阿妹吧！”

74ecf92c-96ed-46fb-b795-22eb281320f1/Opt.en: Is she... praying for Ran Xindu?
74ecf92c-96ed-46fb-b795-22eb281320f1/Opt.cn: 她是在为苒心毒祈祷嘛……

32cd66ea-87e1-4fa5-a412-1edadeaccbfb/Eve.en: Whispers ripple through the crowd as more join their hands in prayer.<NL>A Miao woman removes her silver necklace and lays it before the ritual drum, murmuring:<NL>"Bless her, ancestral spirits—may this kind soul stay in human form and walk the Fortune Bridge with her beloved..."<NL><NL>Moved by her gesture, others follow, placing silver bangles and combs before the drum with soft prayers.<NL>Amid the rising tide of wishes, Ran Xindu trembles slightly, and a single tear falls upon the drumhead...
32cd66ea-87e1-4fa5-a412-1edadeaccbfb/Eve.cn: 人群中低语渐起，越来越多的人合十祈祷，<NL>一位苗家女子解下项间银饰，轻轻置于祭鼓之前，低声祝念：<NL>“先祖保佑，让这位善良呢阿妹能永远保持人形，与心上人携手走过风雨桥……”<NL><NL>四下苗人纷纷动容，皆解下银镯、银梳等贴身之物，置于祭鼓之前，喃喃祈祷，<NL>如潮的祈愿声中，但见苒心毒身躯微微颤动，一滴泪水落于鼓面……

0d152de3-1957-44b1-a0dc-490264f4b2c0/Eve.en: A sudden gust of night wind sets the maple leaves rustling by the drum grounds, like a thousand butterflies taking flight.<NL>Then, streams of radiant light pour in from the eighteen villages, converging like rivulets into a sea, swirling around the Lion's Drum.<NL><NL>As the glow pulses and turns, countless spirit butterflies dance at Ran Xindu's feet.<NL>When the last one sinks into her heart, the light fades away—<NL>and there she stands, a barefoot girl poised atop the drum, the silver bells at her ankles chiming softly.<NL>She lifts her gaze toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, a flush rising to her cheeks, eyes gleaming with emotion: "<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>..."
0d152de3-1957-44b1-a0dc-490264f4b2c0/Eve.cn: 夜风骤起，鼓场旁的枫树叶沙沙作响，仿佛万千蝴蝶振翅，<NL>忽而，道道灵光自十八寨而来，如涓流汇海，萦绕狮子战鼓四周，<NL><NL>光晕流转间，无数灵蝶于苒心毒足边翩然起舞，<NL>当最后一只灵蝶没入苒心毒心口，灵光散去，<NL>但见一名赤足少女婷婷立于鼓面，踝间银铃轻响，<NL>少女抬首望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，颊泛红霞，眼波流转：“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>……”

0d152de3-1957-44b1-a0dc-490264f4b2c0/Opt.en: Xindu... she truly is the Butterfly Mother... The Maple Tree... it really holds a Spirit...
0d152de3-1957-44b1-a0dc-490264f4b2c0/Opt.cn: 心毒……果真蝴蝶妈妈……枫树……有灵……
0d152de3-1957-44b1-a0dc-490264f4b2c0/Opt.ru: Синду... она действительно Мать-бабочка... Клен... в нем действительно есть Дух...

5db9787c-c7ae-4c29-9537-3a05159bf04a/Eve.en: With a bright smile, Ran Xindu throws herself into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s arms:<NL>"It's you, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>... and the prayers of our people... You moved the Butterfly Mother... the Spirit of the Maple Tree... you reached the Ancestors...<NL>From today on, I won't have to turn into a worm anymore—living in a Gu jar was suffocating me!"<NL><NL>Her voice catches. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> feels a damp warmth spread across <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> chest—and something stirs within...
5db9787c-c7ae-4c29-9537-3a05159bf04a/Eve.cn: 苒心毒灿然一笑，一头扑入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>怀中：<NL>“是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>……是族人呢祈祷，感动了蝴蝶妈妈……枫树神灵……感动了先祖……<NL>从今往后，我就不用变成虫子啦，在蛊坛可把我闷死啦！”<NL><NL>苒心毒音声微滞，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>觉得胸前湿润，不由心中一动……

5db9787c-c7ae-4c29-9537-3a05159bf04a/Opt.en: (Gently strokes Ran Xindu...) This is more than I could ever hope for.
5db9787c-c7ae-4c29-9537-3a05159bf04a/Opt.ru: (Нежно гладит Ран Синду...) Это больше, чем я когда-либо мог надеяться.

468f5a5e-9ead-40fd-93d1-c041f85f0bf0/Eve.en: "I'm already the Drum Champion in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>'s heart?!"<NL><NL>Ran Xindu's ears flush pink, yet she lifts her chin and puts on a show of pride.<NL>As Ran Xindu speaks, her bright eyes drift involuntarily toward the ceremonial drum at the center of the arena.<NL>Her voice fades as she reaches the end: "But still..."<NL><NL>Seeing her like this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can't help but feel a pang of softness, and speaks gently to comfort her...
468f5a5e-9ead-40fd-93d1-c041f85f0bf0/Eve.cn: “<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>早就认我是鼓王了嘛！”<NL><NL>苒心毒耳根微红，却仍扬着下巴故作得意，<NL>说话间，一双明眸不由自主地飘向会场中央的祭鼓，<NL>话到末尾，声气渐渐弱了下去：“可是……”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见她这般模样，不由心中一软，温言宽慰道……

468f5a5e-9ead-40fd-93d1-c041f85f0bf0/Opt.en: Remember, a drum speaks through feeling—only when it comes from the heart can it move others.
468f5a5e-9ead-40fd-93d1-c041f85f0bf0/Opt.cn: 你且记得鼓声传情，发自于心，方能感人。
468f5a5e-9ead-40fd-93d1-c041f85f0bf0/Opt.ru: Помните, барабан говорит через чувства — только когда он исходит из сердца, он может тронуть других.
